title: Guriaso language
description: Senu River language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Guriaso or Muno is a language of Papua New Guinea. Only described in 1983, it appears to be distantly related to the Kwomtari and Nai languages. It is spoken in Guriaso ward, Amanab Rural LLG, Sandaun Province.
